verdict.rationale: No evidence AnythingLLM supports ingesting or pointing its agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented doc formats; the only direct evidence is a probe showing AnythingLLM's own docs site returns 404 for llms.txt, suggesting the convention isn't used or supported. General document ingestion features (docs-1/2/3) are for RAG chat, not evidenced as compatible with the llms.txt standard or agent-directed doc discovery.
